# BharatSkillz

> Modern EdTech and career platform offering cohort-based courses, internships, mentorship, and placement assistance for Indian learners.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of programs, mentors, and outcomes.
- [Courses](/courses): Browse all cohort-based courses with pricing and curriculum.
- [Internships](/internships): Marketplace of internship opportunities for students.
- [Career Tracks](/career-tracks): Guided roadmaps from beginner to job-ready.
- [Mentors](/mentors): 1:1 mentors from top product companies.
- [Success Stories](/success-stories): Learner outcomes and placements.
- [Blog](/blog): Articles on careers, skills, and tech.
- [Contact](/contact): Get in touch with the BharatSkillz team.
